description: This file implements a custom EventEmitter class with additional features such as promise handling, max listener management, and event listener management, along with utility functions and types related to event handling.

classes.name: EventEmitter
classes.description: A class that extends Node.js's EventEmitter with additional promise handling and listener management features.

classes.name: OnceWrapper
classes.description: A helper class to wrap event listeners for 'once' semantics, ensuring they are called only once.

classes.name: EventsHelper
classes.description: A utility class providing a static method to add event listeners with automatic disposal.

methods.name: setMaxListeners
methods.description: Sets the maximum number of listeners for the EventEmitter.

methods.name: getMaxListeners
methods.description: Retrieves the maximum number of listeners allowed.

methods.name: emit
methods.description: Emits an event, calling all registered listeners with provided arguments.

methods.name: _callHandler
methods.description: Internal method to invoke a handler and manage promise-based handlers.

methods.name: addListener
methods.description: Adds a new event listener.

methods.name: on
methods.description: Alias for addListener.

methods.name: _addListener
methods.description: Internal method to add a listener, handling 'newListener' events and listener array management.

methods.name: prependListener
methods.description: Adds a listener to the beginning of the listeners array.

methods.name: once
methods.description: Adds a one-time listener for an event.

methods.name: prependOnceListener
methods.description: Adds a one-time listener to the beginning of the listeners array.

methods.name: removeListener
methods.description: Removes a specific listener for an event.

methods.name: off
methods.description: Alias for removeListener.

methods.name: removeAllListeners
methods.description: Removes all listeners for a specific event or all events, with optional behavior for waiting or ignoring errors.

methods.name: _removeAllListeners
methods.description: Internal method to remove all listeners for a given event type.

methods.name: listeners
methods.description: Returns an array of listeners for a specific event.

methods.name: rawListeners
methods.description: Returns an array of all listeners, including wrapped ones, for a specific event.

methods.name: listenerCount
methods.description: Returns the number of listeners for a specific event.

methods.name: eventNames
methods.description: Returns an array of event names for which the emitter has registered listeners.

methods.name: _waitFor
methods.description: Internal async method to wait for all pending handlers of a specific event.

methods.name: _listeners
methods.description: Internal method to retrieve listeners, optionally unwrapping them.
